text:
sara: Quick glitch found during deprecation trial: console's 'compatibility preview' shows per-route quotas but doesn't disambiguate rollover credits vs new quota buckets. Customers reading it think they're seeing their v1 remaining quota.
aj: That sounds like a UX risk. What's the root cause?
lucas: Our quota exporter tags are using `quota_bucket` == normalized(path) which collapses v1 and v2 into same bucket because of earlier normalization. So the UI pulls remaining_quota for that bucket and displays it under the preview row for v1.
tanvi: Proposed UI change: prefix bucket strings in preview with "legacy:" or "active:" based on `original_route` vs `served_variant`. I'll add microcopy to warn that the numbers reflect merged buckets.
sara: Could we instead have the quota meter show both buckets separately if they differ? Even a tiny split-bar would help.
aj: Backend fix: change quota emitter to include `quota_bucket_label` tag with values `legacy:v1` or `active:v2` when a request crosses versions. That way UI can render two meters. Billing unaffected because `billing_route` unchanged.
lucas: I'll add a transformation in the emitter with minimal change footprint: when routeNormalization results in ambiguous_bucket=true, set `quota_bucket_label` accordingly. Add unit tests.
tanvi: I'll mock split-bar and show a tooltip on hover explaining merged vs separate buckets. Also add a small notice: "If you see unexpected usage, contact billing"
ops-bot: scheduled deploy of quota-emitter patch by lucas -> staging 2024-11-12T09:00Z. CI green.
sara: Also we should add a console link to the deprecation playbook when preview shows merged buckets. Help docs need a paragraph on how merged buckets work.
aj: Good. Let's also add an audit job to scan for tenants with `merged_bucket` true in last 30d and surface them to support.
lucas: Will add metric `merged_bucket_count_by_tenant` and a quick dashboard.
tanvi: Will wire UI to consume `quota_bucket_label` and show split bar if two labels present. Low-risk CSS change.
sara: Thanks. Resolve when emitter patch in prod + UI shipped + support list created. :white_check_mark:
